relations.myth: The Norns preserve Yggdrasill from decay
relations.note: They pour water and clay over Yggdrasill to preserve its branches.

relations.myth: Skuld rides with valkyries to battle
relations.note: Skuld rides with Gunnr and Róta to choose the slain and govern battles.

relations.myth: Skuld rides with valkyries to battle
relations.note: Skuld rides with Róta and Gunnr to choose the slain and govern battles.
Some norns are described as originating from or descending from the Æsir.
Some norns are described as being of elvish origin.
Some norns are called daughters of Dvalinn and understood as dwarfish.
Post-medieval comparison equated the Norns iconographically with the Greek Fates.
Antiquaries translated nornir as Parcae, encouraging Classical identification.

relations.myth: The Norns recount history before their rope breaks
relations.note: Wagner portrays the three Norns as daughters or extensions of Erda’s wisdom.
